LanguageData.GrechkaDrones_CaptureDesc: Carry downed enemies to available prison beds. Always rescue your own first, dropping a carried enemy if necessary.
LanguageData.GrechkaDrones_BioEnergyTip: Bioenergy: {0}. A full battery stores 2 nutrition for one day of activity. Refuel with food or charge at a powered dock. Resting in a caravan does not recharge the battery.
